name: Colonial Hardwoods
old_description: Colonial Hardwoods has been a cornerstone in the lumber and building supplies industry since 1976. With over 50 years of combined experience, our team serving Washington, D.C., Maryland, Northern Virginia, Woodbridge, and Fredericksburg, VA, is committed to providing excellent customer service and high-quality products.
about:
Colonial Hardwoods has operated from Springfield, Virginia since 1976. The woman-owned small business began as a lumber supplier and has grown into a full-service woodworking resource for the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, including Maryland, Northern Virginia, Woodbridge, and Fredericksburg.

The company stocks hardwoods, softwoods, exotic species, live-edge slabs, beams, timbers, decking, and cabinet-grade plywood. Its shop provides custom milling, cabinetry, millwork, stair fabrication, flooring, mantels, ceiling beams, butcher-block countertops, spray finishing, and wholesale molding and trim. Projects range from same-day small jobs to two-week turnarounds for larger work.

Customers include professional contractors, remodelers, cabinetmakers, furniture builders, and DIY enthusiasts across residential and light commercial construction. The firm also supplies wholesale lumber to other woodworking businesses.

Colonial Hardwoods emphasizes its five-decade track record, same-day service on small projects, and build-assistance consulting as key differentiators. The ownership cites deep industry knowledge and a commitment to customer satisfaction as the foundation of its longevity.
